cycle.question: Does a fixed gmpy2/MPFR 85-bit backend realize Q007w operation semantics and preserve the exact fixed conservation leaf needed to iterate its re-entry conclusion?

componentwise_encoding_preserves_fixed_l.threshold: exact rational and componentwise MPFR input have identical M, Px, Py on all 4 probes

collision_preserves_fixed_leaf.threshold: post-collision and encoded input have identical M, Px, Py on all 4 probes

streaming_and_filter_preserve_fixed_leaf.threshold: streaming equals collision and filter/full step conserve M, Px, Py exactly on all 4 probes

fixed_leaf_all_iterate_induction_closes.threshold: all five preceding semantic, bound, encoding, collision, and streaming/filter hypotheses pass

cycle.scientific_classification: MPFR-85 realizes the Q007w one-step arithmetic bound but not the fixed conservation leaf
cycle.claim_boundary: The operationwise bridge and finite exact probes validate the registered MPFR-85 implementation and one-step Q007w enclosure. They do not turn finite conservation probes into a tube-wide sampling proof. If encoding or the map fails exact M/Px/Py preservation, the fixed-leaf induction is not certified even when complement-coordinate errors fit the Q007w margins. No performance, multi-step trajectory, GPU, threaded reduction, other MPFR build, or D3Q27 claim is made.
cycle.next_change: If fixed-leaf closure fails while the semantic bridge passes, preregister a conservation-exact encoding and post-stage repair that preserves the Q007w error budget, then audit it separately.
